topic: The Transformational View of Derivatives: From Slopes to Transformations
target_audience: University students (Calculus I or Engineering Physics)

sections.title: Prerequisite Review: The Static Slope
lecture_lines: Derivative is the slope of the tangent line.
Imagine a static curve with a fixed ruler.
The slope represents the rate at a point.
animations: Create a curve (white, #FFFFFF) and a fixed tangent line (yellow, #FFFF00) at a specific point on the curve, using the [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/ruler.svg] to align the tangent.
Highlight the slope triangle (cyan, #00FFFF) formed by the tangent line at the point.
Flash the slope triangle (cyan, #00FFFF) to emphasize the rate of change at that fixed point, measuring it against the [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/ruler.svg].

sections.title: The Shift: Derivative as a Transformation
lecture_lines: View the derivative as a dynamic transformation.
It maps input values to changing output values.
Think of it as a moving speedometer.
animations: Create a functional curve (white, #FFFFFF) and a moving point (red, #FF0000) traveling along it, with a [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/speedometer.svg] displayed in the corner to represent the speed.
Display a vector (green, #00FF00) at the point showing the instantaneous velocity.
Show the vector (green, #00FF00) changing size and orientation as the point moves along the curve.

sections.title: Visualizing the Mapping (The Derivative Machine)
lecture_lines: Left side displays the original function curve.
Right side traces the derivative function path.
This illustrates the derivative as a machine.
animations: Create two side-by-side coordinate planes labeled 'Input' and 'Derivative' with a [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/machine.svg] icon representing the derivative operator.
As a point moves on the left plane, trace its slope value on the right plane.
Reveal the resulting derivative function curve (orange, #FFA500) being drawn on the right plane.

sections.title: Synthesis and Intuition
lecture_lines: Derivatives are operators that warp space.
They describe how functions stretch and change.
These tools prepare you for advanced calculus.
animations: Animate a grid (light blue, #ADD8E6) warping and stretching under the influence of the derivative function, with a subtle overlay of [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/none.svg].
Show the transformation of shapes to visually represent the local rate of change.
Flash the final warped grid (light blue, #ADD8E6) to symbolize the complete derivative operation, accompanied by [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/none.svg].
